entry.title: YouTube’s biggest art collab is falling apart…

media:group.media:title: YouTube’s biggest art collab is falling apart…
Unboxing EVERY Ohuhu Product! (Part 2)
media:group.media:description:
After years of raving about Ohuhu's alcohol markers, I've finally convinced them to send me everything else they make! This is part 2 of probably 3 videos, and today i'm going to mostly focus on their alcohol marker ranges in this one.
This isn't a paid sponsorship, but Ohuhu did send me this product for free. I intend to review it all with as much scrutiny as I always do!
While you wait, check out part 1 here: https://www.youtube.com/live/v-gc1N2RpJ8?si=Juee5V5mN1XkNCUy
Ohuhu on Amazon US: https://amzn.to/4eo2apQ (affiliate link) Amazon AU: https://www.amazon.com.au/stores/Ohuhu/page/A7955758-2453-42DB-973E-87FD63830F83

media:group.media:title: Sorting the 320 Ohuhu alcohol markers
media:group.media:description: The first thing to do with any new set of @ohuhuart markers is to sort them in colours! Everyone approaches this a little differently. I just freehand it and try to make the colours flow well together. But who am I kidding… it won’t stay neat like this! Ohuhu sent me this set to replace my old Honolulu range. And they’ve also sent me many more that I’ll be unboxing in my next livestream on YouTube! They’ve been one of my favourite markers for years and I can’t wait to use them more as I’m getting back into colouring and exploring new techniques! (These were given to me but this isn’t a paid post) #ohuhu #alcoholmarkers

media:group.media:title: I'm colouring differently in 2026
media:group.media:description:
I’m taking a new approach to colouring in 2026. And I call it "Dopamine Colouring" I’m colouring outside the lines, taking risks, and using colours that bring joy and make me smile. I'm enjoying the messy middle more, and I'm loving exploring new colours that I've always avoided (hello neon!)
I'm finding my happy place. And I'd love to know what Dopamine Colouring looks like for you?

entry.title: LIVE: Testing paint pens on cassettes!

media:group.media:title: LIVE: Testing paint pens on cassettes!
media:group.media:description:
I’m working on another big art supply comparison, and I’ve got a fun test to run on stream!
I’m testing over 1500 acrylic paint markers, including Posca, Ohuhu, Arteza, Artistro, Tooli-Art, Copic Acrea, Arrtx, Flysea, Karin, Molotow… and SO many more.
I want to include you on in the painting on plastic test. But to make it fun, I'm making cassette art!
Join me live to draw, compare and tell me your favourites!
